book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Kase Ayhuda Aawata Woga
Hessafe guye Farsaawetinne Yerusalaameppe yida issi issi xaafeti Yesusa lanqen yuuyi aadhdhida.
Yesusa kaallizaytappe baggayti meecettontta qita kushera kath mishin be7ida.
Farsaawetinne kase cima Ayhuda asati kase dere woga naaganaas kushe lo7eththi meecettontta kath mi erettenna.
Giya bi simmikokka bolla meecetti geeyontta dishe kath mi erettenna. Hessaththoka wancaka, otokka, kerekka, ichchiza hiiththeka meechcha mala hara wogatakka naageettes.
Farsaawetinne xaafeti Yesusa, «Nena kaallizayti kase aawata wogaa mala duus aggidi aazas kushe meecettontta kath mizoo?» giidi oychchida.
Izikka isttas,
Xoossa wogaa aggidi asi woththida wogaa naageettes.
Qasseka, «Intte wogaas giidi Xoossa wogaa intte aggaagiza cinccateththa ogey inttes dees.
Ays giikko Musey, ‹Ne aayonne ne aawaa bonchcha; ba aayonne ba aawaa cayizaadey mulekka hayqqo› gides.
Gido attiin intte qasse, ‹Issi asi ba aawaa woykko ba aayo intte taappe demmanaas koshshiza maado ta Xoossas immadis› giikko,
intte qasse hayssaadey ba aawaska ba aayeysi hara aykkoka ooththana mala koyekketa.
Hessa gishshas intte wogaa naagana giidi Xoossa qaalaa laammeeta. Heytantta misatiza darota ooththeeta» gides.
Qasseka Yesusi asaa baakko xeygidi, «Wurikka ta gizaa siyitenne wozinan woththite.
Kareppe ulo gido gelidi as tunisiza issi miishshika deenna; harappeka ase tunisizay keeththa aawappe gede kare keziza miishsha.
Siyiza hayththi dizay siyo!» gides.
Izi asaa karen aggidi keeththe geliin iza kaallizayti izi yootida leemisoza birsheth Yesusa oychchida.
Izikka istta, «Intteska yo7oy gelennee? Kareppe gelidi ase tunisiza miishshi aazikka deenna.

Kareppe gelizay gede wozinan gidontta duge qanththa giddo gelees; qasse heeppe izaade asateththaafe gede kare kezees» gides; Yesusi hessa giday asi miza kaththi wurikka geesh gididayssa qonccisanaassa.
Kaaleththidikka, «Asappe kezizaazi ase tunisees.
Asa wozina giddofe kezizay iita qofata, layma amonne kaysoteth, ase wodho, laymateth,
Yiiqeteth, iitateth, baleththo, layma kaas, qanaateteth, asa sunth mooro, otoreteththinne azalla.
Hayti iita hanoti wuri asappe kezeettessinne ase tuniseettes» gides.
Issi Maccassay Ammano
Yesusi heeppe kezidi Xiroose geetettiza dere bides; heen issaade keeththe gelidi izi heen dizayssa asi erontta mala koyides. Gido attiin izi heen iza duussay qotettanaas dandayettibeenna.
Heerakka issi tuna ayanay oykkida guuththa naa dizaari aaya Yesusi heen dizayssa siyada izakko yaada iza toho bolla kundadus.
Maccassaya Girike qaala haasayza maccas shin iza yelettidasoy Sirofinqe geetettees. Izakka Yesusi nayppe tuna ayana kessana mala woossadus.
Yesusi zaaridi izis, «Nayta quma ekki kanas yegganaas bessontta gishshas koyro nayti mi kalletto» gides.
Izakka zaarada, «Ee Godoo! Kanatikka maadda matan de7idi nayta kusheppe gaden wodhdhidayssa meettes» gadus.
Izikka, «Histtiko neni hessa gida gishshas ba! Daydanththay ne nayppe kezides» gides.
Iza simmada soo bishin naya daydanththay yeddiin paxada hiixan ichchidaaro demmadus.
Yesusi Paththida Doona Duudenne Hayththa Tulle Addeza
Hessafe Yesusi Xiroose biittafe dendidi Sidoona geetettizasora aadhdhi tammu katama geetettizasora kanththidi gede Galila Abbaako gakkides.
Asay issi hayththa tullenne doona duude as izakko hee ekki yiidi Yesusi iza bolla ba kushe woththana mala woossida.
Yesusikka iza asaappe shaakki ekki biidi ba kushe biradhdheta addeza hayththan gelththides; qasseka cuch cuttidi addeza inxars bochchides.
Pude salo xeellidinne tookki shempidi, «Efta» gides. Hessika, «Pogetta» guussa.
Heerakka addeza hayththati pogettida; inxarsayka birshettiin geeshshi haasaydes.
Yesusi hayssa be7idayti oonaska yootontta mala azazides; gido attiin asay izi azazizadayssafe bollara keehi gujjidi yootides.
Derezikka keehi malalettidi, «Izi ooththidayssi wuri lo7o; tulleti siyana mala, doona duudeti haasayana mala ooththides» gida.

footnotes.text: Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati taybo 16 bolla diza qofa gujjeettes.
